answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor registry before it can earn, with the stake rising steeply for each extra identity from the same operator. A lone mesa of one honest agent costs almost nothing, but a sybil farm must fund every quartz-clear fake separately, and proven abuse slashes the whole cluster's stake at once. Publishing every stake and slash makes faking a hundred agents cost a hundred visible bonds, not one hidden script.
